tagline: Mountains that drop straight into the Pacific.
intro: Highway 1 through Big Sur follows a steep, largely undeveloped coastline where the Santa Lucia Mountains meet the ocean. The road is carved into the slope and crosses a series of canyons on high bridges.
Landslides close parts of this road for long periods. Check Caltrans for current status before planning a through trip.
season: Spring for wildflowers, autumn for clearer skies. Summer mornings are often foggy.

moments.title: Bixby Creek Bridge
moments.text: A concrete arch bridge high above the mouth of Bixby Creek.

moments.title: Point Sur
moments.text: A lighthouse on a volcanic rock off the coast, visited on guided tours.

moments.title: McWay Falls
moments.text: A waterfall that drops onto the beach of a small cove, seen from a short trail.
